subject: Pandora RDP SSH access to canonical source and Memory repositories

verification.finalAclReadback: both private keys owned by Administrator with only Administrator Read/Synchronize allow ACE

failuresAndCorrections.failure: PowerShell collapsed ssh-keygen empty passphrase arguments and returned Too many arguments.
failuresAndCorrections.correction: Generate Ed25519 keys through cmd.exe so -N empty is preserved.

failuresAndCorrections.failure: Initial private-key ACL included BUILTIN Administrators and Windows OpenSSH rejected the keys as unprotected.
failuresAndCorrections.correction: Rebuilt the key ACL and transferred final ownership to the exact local Administrator SID only.

failuresAndCorrections.failure: Managed GitHub App could not create the Memory evidence branch because repository mutation returned 403 Resource not accessible by integration.
failuresAndCorrections.correction: Use the existing fixed-scope Supabase Vault-backed Github_supabase broker; no provider credential value leaves Vault.

durableLessons: Historical SSH lesson: one repository-scoped deploy key per repository limits credential blast radius when such access is explicitly needed.
Historical SSH lesson: pin the GitHub host key and require StrictHostKeyChecking before changing an SSH origin.
Historical Windows OpenSSH lesson: validate private-key ACLs against the exact local user SID.
Current Pandora source authority is direct GitHub plus the approved Supabase Vault-backed Github_supabase broker; RDP SSH is not a current authorization dependency.
When the managed GitHub App cannot mutate a canonical repository, use the approved fixed-scope Supabase Vault-backed Github_supabase broker without exposing credential material.

provenance.provider: GitHub deploy-key readback through Supabase Vault-backed fixed-scope broker

currentAuthorityBoundary.note: Retain this record only as historical evidence that the named RDP had repository-scoped SSH access on 2026-09-25. Do not use it as current Pandora execution authorization, architecture preference, or a requirement for source work.
